# SME Workshop Notes Template

Roadmap "P1 — reusable domain onboarding and governance pack". One file per
workshop session with the domain's subject-matter experts, kept alongside
the domain's other onboarding artifacts — not folded into meeting-minutes
email threads that don't survive past the project.

## Session

- Domain / tenant: `<e.g. insurance-underwriting>`
- Date: `<YYYY-MM-DD>`
- Attendees and roles: `<name (SME/architect/engineer/product)>`
- Facilitator: `<name>`

## Entities and relationships discussed

| Candidate type/relation | SME description | Real-world example given | Confidence this is in scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<candidate name>` | `<what the SME said it means>` | `<a concrete instance they named>` | `high \| medium \| low` |

## Decisions made in this session

Link each decision to its row in
`domain-onboarding-entity-relationship-decisions-template.md` rather than
restating it here — this file is the raw discussion record, that one is the
reviewable decision log.

## Open items raised

Link each open item to its row in
`domain-onboarding-unresolved-questions-template.md` — same separation:
this file captures that a question was raised and by whom, the unresolved-
questions log tracks it to closure.
